items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 27 at 2:13PM EST until November 28 at 10:00AM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...1 to 2 feet of inundation above ground level in low-
lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...Areas along the beaches, Albemarle, Croatan, and
Roanoke Sounds, Kitty Hawk Bay, and adjacent tidal creeks.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM EST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...1 to 2 feet of inundation above ground level is
possible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways
resulting in a low threat of property damage. Some roads and low
lying property including parking lots, parks, lawns, and homes
adjacent to the waterfront will experience shallow flooding.
Portions of NC-12 may be impacted.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 27 at 6:48PM EST until November 28 at 1:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas
5 to 8 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Duck to Oregon Inlet.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM EST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Some infrequent gale force gusts (34kt)
will be possible over outer portions of these waters for a few
more hours.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
